flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ then Find a stock or scarcity message on the first product (for example "Only 3 left" or "12 in stock") and store its exact text as stock_1.
Get the product name from the first product and save as {{first_product_name}}.
Reload the page and store {{first_product_name}}'s stock message as stock_2.
Reload once more and store it as stock_3.
Do not add anything to the cart.
If there is no stock message, @v16:"store \"none\" for all three."
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.
